meta.name: drive-desktop-app
meta.description: Drive and verify an Electron or Tauri desktop app from the inside, including the main-process and Rust IPC calls a browser tool cannot see. Use when a desktop app needs testing, when a feature works in the browser but not in the packaged app, when an IPC or invoke call needs proving, when a desktop screenshot or visual diff is wanted, or when you need a headless run of a desktop UI in CI.

copy.tagline: 从内部驱动并验证桌面应用,把主进程与 IPC 调用一起测通
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果功能在浏览器正常、打包成桌面应用后就失灵。
copy.tagline_en: Drive and verify a desktop app from the inside, testing main-process and IPC calls too
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a feature works in the browser but breaks in the packaged desktop app.

howto.what: Claude 可以驱动并验证 Electron 或 Tauri 桌面应用，包括浏览器工具看不到的主进程 IPC 和 Rust invoke 调用。它能断言这些调用是否成功、截图和做视觉对比，并在 CI 里无头运行桌面界面。
howto.when: 当桌面应用需要测试、某个功能在浏览器里正常但打包后失效，或要验证 IPC/invoke 调用等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证这个 Electron 应用点击归档后 IPC 调用是否成功
这个功能在浏览器里正常，打包后就不行，帮我查一下
say.note: 会检查 preload 是否加了 shim 那一行

say.text: 在 CI 里无头跑一下这个 Tauri 桌面界面并截图

howto.what_en: Claude can drive and verify an Electron or Tauri desktop app, including main-process IPC and Rust invoke calls a browser tool cannot see. It asserts those calls, takes screenshots, and runs the desktop UI headless in CI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a desktop app needs testing, a feature works in the browser but not the packaged app, or an IPC/invoke call needs proving.

say_en.text: Verify the IPC call succeeds when I click archive in this Electron app
say_en.note: Uses reticle_act_and_wait to assert the ipc:// call

say_en.text: This works in the browser but not in the packaged app — find out why
say_en.note: Checks whether the preload shim line is present

say_en.text: Run this Tauri desktop UI headless in CI and take a screenshot
